briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI accelerate frontier model releases as global compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI landscape shows rapid frontier model iteration with OpenAI and Google pushing multimodal capabilities. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with enhanced reasoning; xAI launched Grok-3; DeepSeek unveiled R2. Meta's Llama 4 open weights sparked developer adoption.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic AI risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1M units; Microsoft expands Stargate data centers in Texas. TSMC reports 3nm AI chip yields improving.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems outpace single-model safety alignments by 2027?
